method: Pure production normalizeRdwVehicle path over freshly retrieved and independently status-verified RDW rows. This excludes network latency. Purposive breadth sample; no population extrapolation. HTTP/browser checks are recorded separately. Only hashed registration IDs are persisted.

registrationVerification.method: Bounded exact registration join: present in current RDW register, export_indicator=Nee, nonempty datum_tenaamstelling and tenaamstellen_mogelijk=Ja. This verifies the published registration state, not insurance, road use or mechanical condition.

memory.note: Process RSS/heap includes the canonical catalog and runtime imports; not isolated source dataset memory.
